'''May 2001 Milford tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in TJ's Collectibles, Milford, MA in May 2001. [[Hayes Hunter]] won it. It is known from Michael Schiemer's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2245">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-06-milford-mad2245/ milford-ma], DeckTech (Michael "The Rattler" Schiemer, 6 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-06-milford-mad2245/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 5 May 2001<ref name="tr-d2265" />
* '''Site:''' TJ's Collectibles, Milford, MA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 12
* '''Winner:''' [[Hayes Hunter]]

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* Michael Pistone's report gives 18 players (17 plus Hayes Hunter); the hub's 12 comes from Michael Schiemer's 'around 12'.<ref name="tr-d2265" />
* Hayes Hunter's report gives 16 players in round 1 and 18 after (two late arrivals), and his final as 6–0, 12 (+143); the hub's 12 players comes from Michael Schiemer's 'around 12'.<ref name="tr-d2280" />
